outlets.name: Jeunes Restaurateurs d'Europe
outlets.credible: Curated European association of young chef-patrons; membership is a peer-vetted merit signal.

outlets.name: DER FEINSCHMECKER

outlets.credible: Major Luxembourg business-and-lifestyle title; its recurring 'où manger luxembourgeois' guides are credible local editorial (French/English).

outlets.name: Visit Remich (office de tourisme)

outlets.name: Ville de Metz (official city site)
outlets.credible: City of Metz official site; authoritative on Metz monuments and squares (French).

outlets.name: Visit Grand Est
outlets.credible: Official tourism board for the Grand Est region (French/English).

outlets.name: Trierischer Volksfreund (volksfreund.de)

outlets.name: Rheinischer Spiegel
outlets.credible: Regional Rhineland-Palatinate online magazine; food and culture features (German).

outlets.name: Tourist-Information Trier (trier-info.de)
outlets.credible: Official Trier tourist information; authoritative on Trier sights, wine and gastronomy (German/English).

outlets.name: Top Magazin Trier
outlets.credible: Regional lifestyle city magazine for Trier and the region; local restaurant features (German).
